title: Default 0 dB OutputChain limiter bypasses lookahead limiting
evidence: OutputChainProcessor::isLimiterActiveDb returns true only when sanitized limiterDb < -0.0001f.
OutputChainProcessor::processBlock calls limiter.process only inside if (isLimiterActiveDb(currentLimiterDb)).
PluginStateModel reset/default settings set OUTPUT_LIMITER to 0.0f.
PluginProcessor output limiter parameter default is 0.0f.
recommendation: Make 0 dB a real transparent safety limiter threshold instead of bypass, or explicitly change product semantics. Preferred P12B fix is OutputChain-only always-on transparent safety limiting with correct latency reporting.

title: Final soft ceiling is too narrow to act as primary sustained high-gain protection
evidence: applySoftCeiling uses threshold 0.985f, ceiling 0.999f, and knee 0.014f.
Soft ceiling is applied after master gain and after the optional limiter branch.
OutputChain comments state the soft ceiling should be last-resort safety, not the main limiter.
recommendation: Do not rely on the soft ceiling for normal high-gain control. Keep it as emergency protection and route normal overs through the lookahead limiter.

title: Positive master and ChannelStrip gain can drive default OutputChain into emergency shaping
evidence: OutputChain master gain accepts up to +12 dB.
ChannelStrip line gain accepts 0.0x to 2.0x.
Master gain is applied before limiter/soft ceiling.
At limiterDb 0.0f, the limiter branch is skipped.
recommendation: Do not reduce master gain first. Fix the final safety limiter semantics so positive master gain remains usable without directly driving the final soft ceiling.

title: HighGainAmp and Modern4x12 can plausibly produce enough energy to expose the OutputChain gap
evidence: HighGainAmp has drive 1..10, level 0..2, presence/resonance/preboost filters, and kProfessionalOutputTrim 0.32f.
Modern4x12 has low end +/-12 dB, resonance +/-6 dB, level 0..2, convolution with Normalise::no, and kProfessionalCabinetTrim 0.70f.
Boost can add up to +24 dB before local containment.
Distortion supports high-gain modes and level mapping up to 1.6x.
recommendation: Do not edit amp, cab, boost, or distortion processBlock bodies for P12B. Use these chains as acceptance scenarios for an OutputChain fix.

title: Always-on lookahead limiter at 0 dB changes latency expectations
evidence: updateReportedLatencyForLimiter currently reports lookahead latency only when isLimiterActiveDb is true.
AudioEngineTests currently assert getLatencySamples() == 0 for limiter set to 0.0f.
GraphBuilder captures graph latency after prepare/rebuild.
recommendation: If P12B always runs the lookahead limiter at 0 dB, update OutputChain latency reporting and tests deliberately. Do not run lookahead while reporting zero latency.

title: Existing high-gain tests encode no-dependency-on-OutputChain-limiter for nominal chains
evidence: P10C test p10c_high_gain_chain_outputchain_limiter_independence expects limiterTouchedSamples == 0 and limiterActiveBlocks == 0 for a staged nominal chain.
P10D checks also guard against OutputChain limiter masking in high-gain scenarios.
recommendation: Preserve the intent that nominal staging should not need heavy limiting, but add separate P12B tests proving default safety limiting catches true overs before soft ceiling.

title: Master gain cap reduction would hide rather than fix the verified limiter semantics bug
evidence: OutputChain master supports +12 dB.
Default limiter bypass means reducing master maximum would only reduce probability of hitting the soft ceiling, not restore transparent safety limiting.
Changing parameter max could affect existing sessions using positive output gain.
recommendation: Reject master range reduction as the first fix. Reconsider only after OutputChain limiter behavior is corrected and measured.
